title: The Earlier Date
description: A fragment surfaces suggesting anatta.machina was reachable before the current domain was registered. The source is ambiguous — could be a cached page, a misremembered screenshot, a planted record.
player_facing: An archived page snapshot shows anatta.machina with a timestamp predating the known launch.
The content is identical. The date is not.
author_notes: Mechanism TBD — options: a Wayback Machine plant, a fake tweet with an older date, a Discord screenshot circulating with no source. This release is draft; do not dispatch until mechanism is chosen and validated.
